heading: Questions before you book
seo_description: Booking, deposits, what is included, insurance, cancellations and walking on Cassino Battlefields tours.
image_caption: Group just below Point 593 the Carpathian Memorial in May 2022

faqs.question: How do I book and pay the deposit?
faqs.answer: A non-refundable deposit of £80 per person holds your place. Pay in pounds sterling by bank transfer or cheque, made payable to Cassino Battlefields. The balance is due seven weeks before departure. [Ask Frank for a booking form](/contact/).

faqs.question: What happens to my money?
faqs.answer: Your payment is held in a trust account and is not paid to Cassino Battlefields until after the tour has taken place.

faqs.question: What is included?
faqs.answer:
- Minibus or coach transport from Rome (Ciampino or Fiumicino), Naples (Capodichino) or Ancona airport to every location on the tour. The vehicle stays with the group throughout.
- Bed and continental breakfast each day in Cassino, Anzio, Rimini or Salerno. All rooms are en-suite with wifi, TV and telephone.
- A comprehensive briefing pack for each room booked, covering the background to and an overview of the battles.

faqs.question: What is not included?
faqs.answer:
- Flights or other travel to and from the airport. You arrange these yourself, which makes it easy to arrive early or stay on in Rome.
- Lunch, snacks and evening meals.
- Travel insurance.

faqs.question: Do I need a passport?
faqs.answer: Yes, a valid passport. [Check yours on GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/browse/abroad/passports).

faqs.question: Do I need travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. You will not be able to travel without it, and we need proof of insurance with your booking form. UK residents should also carry a UK Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC), which is free to apply for on the NHS website.

faqs.question: What if I need to cancel?
faqs.answer:
Cancellations must be made in writing. These charges apply:

| Notice before departure | Charge |
| --- | --- |
| 56 to 21 days | 30% |
| 20 to 14 days | 75% |
| 13 to 7 days | 90% |
| Less than 7 days | No refund |

If we have to cancel a tour, we will tell you in writing and offer an alternative. If that does not suit you, we will refund everything you have paid.

faqs.question: I’m already in Italy. Can I just join the study?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you have your own accommodation, the price is reduced, and it is reduced further if you also have your own transport.

faqs.question: Do I have to share a room?
faqs.answer: No. Single and twin rooms are both available, at different prices.

faqs.question: How much walking is there?
faqs.answer: Not much. Where there is walking, the minibus is never far away.
